svg.metadata: Native editable SVG reconstruction of the user-supplied 1672 × 941 reference. All Chinese labels are live text. Architecture, industrial equipment, smoke, snowy trees and geological textures are approximated as independent vector components; no bitmap is embedded. Font fallback: Noto Sans CJK SC / Microsoft YaHei, title Noto Serif CJK SC / SimSun.
